name: VPNDetection.io API
tier_rationale: Terms and operator not reviewed by legal (P046 cond 1: every provider is terms 'unknown' and tier unknown until legal reviews it). Unknown tier: never default, excluded at AMBER and above, --allow-unknown at CLEAR/GREEN, IOC values only (A8).

reliability.justification: Reliability cannot be judged until the operator is reviewed (A8 unknown); one vote among >= 3 independent providers (P046 cond 6).

api.title: VPNDetection IP lookup (GET /{ip}: is_vpn, is_tor, asn.type)

terms.quote: P046 cond 1 (binding council text): Every provider (VPNDetection, IPQuery, IPLocate, InternetData, ipapi.is, proxycheck.io) is terms 'unknown' and tier unknown until legal reviews it: disabled in every profile until legal records its terms (A1).

api.notes: Research C0095 (verified_live 200; advertised 'FREE (no key, no cap)'). Shares its backend and JSON schema with InternetData: one family, counted once (P046 cond 5). Votes vpn (is_vpn), tor (is_tor), hosting (asn.type). Used by ip_anonymizer_consensus.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G02-2 (P046). InternetData (api.internetdata.io, same backend) is not wired: it would never add an independent vote and P046 cond 4 caps the wired providers at 4.
